shadows.name: raised-drop

components.name: Control
components.description: Standard button or toggle, Roomy density.

components.name: Numeral readout
components.description: Primary value such as BPM, in mono.

narrative.overview: One faceplate, not nested cards. Three columns run top to bottom: deck A, the mixer, deck B, and deck B mirrors A. Parts are near-square, surfaces are matte warm neutrals, and structure comes from etched 1px lines rather than shadow or light.
keyCharacteristics: Matte, warm, near-black ground with muted deck colours.
Depth from 1px inset lines and tonal steps; no glow, no blur.
Fibonacci spacing steps; Compact is Roomy shifted down one step.
Light mode darkens every colour to hold contrast in daylight.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks the playhead and recording, nothing else.

rules.name: The Low-Band Rule
rules.body: In waveforms, low frequencies take the deck colour and highs sit in neutral on top.

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number is Ubuntu Mono so values do not shift width as they change.

rules.name: The Lines Not Light Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines and tonal steps. No halos, no blur, no bloom.

dos: Do pair every deck hue with its letter (A–D).
Do build structure with 1px etched lines and tonal steps.
Do set every number in Ubuntu Mono.
Do reserve signal red (#ef5a3f) for the playhead and record.
donts: Don't add glow, blur or bloom to show an active state.
Don't go below 11px for a label or 12px for running prose.
